items.title: PHP security releases — patch affected runtimes
items.summary: Security releases for supported PHP branches (8.4.x, 8.3.x, 8.2.x, 8.1.x). Review the official changelog for CVEs fixed in your branch.
items.actionRequired: Upgrade application servers, containers, and CI images to the latest patch for your PHP minor version.

items.title: Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228) — legacy Java stacks
items.summary: Remote code execution in Log4j 2.x via JNDI lookup. Many EMEA estates still carry aged Java middleware.
items.actionRequired: Confirm no Log4j 2.0–2.14.1; use 2.17.1+ or vendor-supported backports. Scan images and dependency trees.

items.title: Java Critical Patch Update — review quarterly CPU
items.summary: CPU bundles security fixes across supported JDK/LTS releases. Spring and application servers inherit JVM patches.
items.actionRequired: Align JDK patch level with vendor CPU for versions in production; schedule rolling restarts after test.
